incidents.summary: A Hiscox manager faces a criminal charge in Greece over allegedly false evidence submitted in 2019 and 2020 to support a former colleague’s extradition, and denies wrongdoing.

sources.title: Hiscox Manager Faces Greek Perjury Charge Over Extradition Case
sources.quote: A manager at London-listed insurer Hiscox faces a criminal charge of providing false testimony during an attempted extradition of a former colleague from Greece to Bermuda, court proceedings and filings seen by Reuters show.

sources.title: Hiscox manager faces charge in Greece over Bermuda case - The Royal Gazette | Bermuda News, Business, Sports, Events, & Community |
sources.quote: An Athens prosecutor alleges the manager submitted false evidence in 2019 and 2020 in support of a request to extradite Yuval Abraham, a former Hiscox Services Ltd chief financial officer, to Bermuda, according to court filings seen by Reuters.

sources.title: Hiscox Manager Faces Greek Perjury Charge Over Extradition Case
sources.quote: A lawyer for the Hiscox manager told an Athens court hearing on March 4 that his client denied wrongdoing and that the case should be struck out because a court summons had been served in Greek rather than English.

incidents.summary: Hiscox exited a lawsuit concerning allegedly mishandled motor insurance claims through a settlement after being accused of voiding a broker’s indemnity policy.

sources.title: Hiscox Drops Out Of £9M Motor Claims Suit With Settlement - Law360
sources.quote: Hiscox Drops Out Of £9M Motor Claims Suit With Settlement

sources.title: Hiscox Drops Out Of £9M Motor Claims Suit With Settlement - Law360
sources.quote: Hiscox has dropped out of an £8.8 million ($11 million) London lawsuit over allegedly mishandled motor insurance claims, months after being accused of voiding a broker's indemnity policy.

positives: Hiscox ruled out insurance for Adani’s Carmichael coal mine project.
